concepts.why: The answer stores 7.9 but says nothing about the double type, its values or how it behaves.

After the hint, the student works out the index of the next-to-last element and writes 7.9 to exactly that element. Turn 1 used sensorReadings[sensorReadings.length], which is out of bounds, but turn 2 corrects it.
The student uses the rule that the last element is at a.length-1 and correctly gets length-2 for this task, with no parentheses after length.
Only after the hint does the student correctly state that the last legal index is length-1. They never say why the turn-1 index sensorReadings.length was out of range.
